name: 3can-runtimehook
description: Orient every Codex session to the 3CAN fast path and keep long-task semantic review current.

interface.longDescription: An offline Codex companion that gives every SessionStart a bounded 3CAN fast path, then optionally restores Owner Intent at Git, plan, prompt, resume, and final boundaries for semantic review.
defaultPrompt: Use 3CAN RuntimeHook for this task with the lightest useful review intensity.
Run this long cross-module task with 3CAN RuntimeHook.
Turn off 3CAN RuntimeHook for the current worktree.
